analysis.headline: Shares Your Data Widely
analysis.quote: We also share personal data with vendors or agents working on our behalf for the purposes described in this statement. For example, companies we've hired to provide customer service support or assist in protecting and securing our systems and services may need access to personal data to provide those functions.

analysis.headline: Trains AI on Your Data
analysis.quote: As part of our efforts to improve and develop our products, we may use your data to develop and train our AI models.

analysis.headline: Collects Many Data Types
analysis.quote: The data we collect can include the following: Name and contact data. Credentials. Demographic data. Payment data. Subscription and licensing data. Interactions. Device and usage data. Payment and account history. Browse history. Device, connectivity, and configuration data. Error reports and performance data. Troubleshooting and help data. Bot usage data. Interests and favorites. Content consumption data. Searches and commands. Voice data. Text, inking, and typing data. Images. Contacts and relationships. Social data. Location data. Biometric data and identifiers. Other input. Content. Video or recordings. Feedback and ratings. Traffic data.

analysis.headline: Acquires Data from Brokers
analysis.quote: We also obtain data about you from Microsoft affiliates, subsidiaries, and third parties... Data brokers from which we purchase demographic data to supplement the data we collect.

analysis.headline: Collects Your Biometric Data
analysis.quote: Biometric data and identifiers . Data about you resulting from specific technical processing relating to your physical, physiological, or behavioral characteristics which allow or confirm unique identification. Our collection and use of biometric data depends on the products and features you use in certain Microsoft products, as well as your consent.

analysis.headline: Scans Your Private Content
analysis.quote: For example, some of our products, such as Outlook.com or OneDrive, systematically scan content in an automated manner to identify suspected spam, viruses, abusive actions, or URLs that have been flagged as fraud, phishing, or malware links; and we reserve the right to block delivery of a communication or remove content if it violates our terms.

analysis.headline: Records Your Support Calls
analysis.quote: When you contact us, such as for customer support, phone conversations or chat sessions with our representatives may be monitored and recorded.

analysis.headline: Records Your Image, Voice
analysis.quote: If you enter Microsoft Store locations or other facilities, or attend a Microsoft event that is recorded, we may process your image and voice data.

analysis.headline: Limits Features Without Data
analysis.quote: If you choose not to provide data -required to provide you with a product or feature, you cannot use that product or feature.
